title: LA Helicopter Tour with Malibu Landing
includes: Sparkling California Champagne for 21 + over only
30-45 minute landing at scenic Malibu pad
Transportation to and from attractions (not included)
Tips - it is customary to tip your pilot (not included)
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Minimum of 2 people per booking is required.
All passenger heights and weights be advised at time of booking

Passenger Weights: The safety and comfort of our passengers is very important to us. Therefore it is necessary that each passenger be asked for their height and weight. The distribution of weight is vital to safety in a helicopter and it is our responsibility to make sure that the aircraft is not overloaded or out of balance. There are also per seat weight limits for each aircraft. Total weight of all Passengers, not to exceed 600 lbs. For passengers weighing over 250 lbs. please call our office.
Due to uneven surfaces, this tour is not recommended for those with walking disabilities or those using a wheelchair
For safety reasons, the helicopter cannot accommodate any passengers weighing more than 300 pounds (136 kilos). If over 250 lbs please contact operator.
Alcoholic beverages only served to adults 21 and over. Non-alcoholic refreshments available upon request
policies: It is the company’s policy is to verify both credit card used to book + government issued identification before the flight. Please be prepared to show these items at check in.
Subject to favorable weather conditions. If cancelled due to poor weather, you will be given the option of an alternative date or full refund.

At any given time, the federal government imposes Temporary Flight Restrictions (TFRs) which essentially closes the airspace over certain areas and prohibiting civil aircraft from flyovers. In Los Angeles, airspace is closed when VIPs such as the president are in town. Also, when Dodgers or Rams are playing, we are restricted from flying over or near these sports stadiums. We do our best to monitor TFRs and in most cases we have 24 to 48 hr. warnings. But in some cases, flight restrictions can be imposed with no warning. The LA Dodger games usually affects the Downtown LA portion of our tours.
Passengers are advised to dress in layers. Weather here can vary from very hot to very cool. We advise carrying a warm jacket.
Passengers are advised to wear closed toe shoes as terrain is uneven.

The landing site is a public site with permission granted to Group 3 for landing. Landing position of the aircraft may not always be near the picnic table if and when hikers access the site. Public ground access to the site is beyond the company’s control. We cannot guarantee use of the picnic area.
It is the company's policy is to verify both credit card used to book + government issued identification. Please be prepared to have these prior to your flight.
IMPORTANT: Must have a lead contact email and mobile number. No exceptions.
cancellation: All sales are final. No refund is available for cancellations.
blurb:
Take your Los Angeles trip to new heights during this private 50 minute in the air helicopter sightseeing flight and 30 at the pad, including a spectacular landing. Get a bird’s-eye view of L.A. attractions like Santa Monica Pier, Beverly Hills, Hollywood Sign the Getty Museum and various celebrity homes before setting down on a private hilltop landing pad.

- Take a scenic helicopter flight complete with landing on a private Malibu peak. 

- Enjoy bird's-eye views of Santa Monica Pier, Hollywood Sign, Beverly Hills, the Getty Museum, and celebrity homes.

- Soak up stunning views of the Pacific.

- Romantic experience that's perfect for couples and special occasions.
